overview.description: The MicroSectors 3x Long Japan ETNs (JPNU) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the VettaFi Japan Equity Fund-Tracking index. The fund seeks 3x leveraged exposure, reset daily, to the share price performance of VettaFi Japan Equity Fund Tracking Index that, in turn, tracks the performance of the iShares MSCI Japan ETF (Ticker: EWJ). JPNU was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
